question: Should maintainers keep this useful external export-guard PR open for contributor refresh/proof, adopt it as a maintainer-owned replacement, or close it despite the earlier member engagement?
rationale: Auto-close is not safe because the branch contains a narrow useful guard and has a member comment; automation also cannot supply the contributor's real packaged-plugin proof.

options.title: Keep open for refresh and proof
options.body: Ask the contributor to update the branch and attach redacted build/plugin validation output before merge.

options.title: Adopt or replace narrowly
options.body: A maintainer can recreate the same guard on current main if the contributor does not return but the release guard is still wanted soon.

options.title: Close as no longer worth carrying
options.body: If maintainers do not want to wait for proof or adopt the guard, close with an invitation for a fresh proven PR.

recommendation.title: Keep open for refresh and proof
recommendation.body: Ask the contributor to update the branch and attach redacted build/plugin validation output before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this owner candidate to the checker, plugin SDK surface, and realtime/security helper surfaces affected by the guard.
